rationale: Common reasons to switch: simplifying dosing, leveraging fluoxetine's long half-life to auto-taper, or planning a future switch where the long norfluoxetine washout is acceptable. Brief cross-taper is sufficient because fluoxetine reaches steady state slowly and sertraline is moderate-disc-risk only. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start fluoxetine 20 mg in the morning. Hold sertraline 100 mg.
Halve sertraline to 50 mg. Hold fluoxetine 20 mg.
Stop sertraline. Continue fluoxetine 20 mg. Norfluoxetine will auto-taper any residual sertraline-like effect over weeks.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: sertraline 100 mg ≈ fluoxetine 20 mg (Maudsley 14th). Note: this switch commits the patient to a multi-week wash-IN of fluoxetine and a 5-week washout requirement before any future MAOI. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
